name: CRM round trip by record ID (Synthaveil → AI → write-back)

nodes.name: Synthaveil Tokenize
nodes.notes: Only name and email are listed. `id` and `body` are untouched — `id` because it is your own reference, `body` because free text needs Local restore (v1.1).

nodes.name: Merge on record ID
nodes.notes: Input 1 = the original CRM rows (real names, never left n8n). Input 2 = the model's answers. They join on `id` — the join Synthaveil never needed to know about.

nodes.name: Write back to CRM
nodes.notes: Replace with your real CRM node. The point of the example: the summary lands on the right ticket, under the real customer name, and no mapping was stored anywhere to make that happen.
